jobs_results.title: Consultor​/a Data Scientist Senior con inglés
jobs_results.description:
Location: Pozuelo de Alarcón

Job Purpose:

As Data Scientist, you will be the responsible on proactively fetching information from various sources and analyse it for better understanding about how the business performs, and to build AI tools that automate certain processes within the company.

Main Account abilities and tasks:

Rapidly architect, design, prototype, and implement architectures to tackle the Big Data and Data Science needs for Adecco Business
Research, experiment, and utilize leading Big Data technologies, Data Lakes, SQL and no SQL databases, Microsoft stack will be a plus.
Extending companys data with third party sources of information when needed
Enhancing data collection procedures to include information that is relevant for building analytic systems
Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis
Doing ad-hoc analysis and presenting results in a clear manner
Building high quality prediction systems integrated with our... products

Requisitos

Requirements:

Technical knowledge

Programming languages:
Python (R will be also considered)
Big data analytics, data mining and predictive analysis
ML/DL general knowledge:
Supervised learning techniques: linear and logistics regression, Bayesian networks, random forest, xgboost, ANN,Unsupervised learning techniques: hierarchical and agglomerative clustering, ontology models
ML/DL framework stack:
Keras/Tensor flow, Scikit-Learn, Numpy, Pandas (Pytorch will be also considered)
Data engineer knowledge: databases management, cluster architectures, programming/scripting languages and data processing systems

Experience

Required:

At least 4 years of proven experience as data scientist

Experience working with relational databases
At least 2 years of experience with programming, data analysis, problem solving and algorithm developing
At least 2 years of experience with python and SQL
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English

¿ Qué ofrecemos?
To be considered:

Experience with Big Data technologies, Spark, SQL/No SQL databases, etc

Experience with Microsoft Azure
Reporting tools and data discovering tools (Power BI and Microstrategy)
Model deployment in both on-premise and Cloud (Azure)
Dynamic pricing modelling experience
BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering or relevant field; graduate degree in Data Science or other quantitative field is preferred
#J-18808-Ljbffr

➥ Unirte a Innova, es formar parte de una empresa de consultoría líder a nivel nacional y en pleno desarrollo internacional. Si estás interesado en participar en proyectos innovadores de IA, Cloud Computing y Transformación Digital, creemos este es tu lugar 😊

Nuestros proyectos alcanzan diversos sectores de la industria, como energético, retail, bancario y más.

• Experiencia laboral en análisis web.
• Experiencia del almenos 1 año con Adobe Analytics.
• Conocimiento en la gestión de etiquetas y datos con Tealium asi como en la configuración de Tealium y Adobe Analytics.

• Contrato indefinido, invertimos y buscamos tu desarrollo a largo plazo.

• Planes de carrera personalizados, adaptados a fortalezas e intereses profesionales y basados en evaluaciones de desempeño anuales.

jobs_results.title: Consultor google bigquery
jobs_results.description:
De cara a proyecto de Big Data, demandamos un consultor con el siguiente perfil:

•Experiencia y/o conocimientos profundos de SQL atendiendo a las particularidades de BigQuery sobre todo desde el punto de vista de rendimiento y gasto
•Experiencia y/o conocimientos de modelado de datos
•Experiencia y/o conocimientos de diseño de dashboards en Data Studio y Tableau
•Experiencia y/o conocimientos deseables de Python y Airflow

Funciones:
- Tomar los requerimientos del cliente final o de un analista de negocio, y partiendo de los datos del transaccional o de lo ya disponible en el data hub, diseñar los conjuntos de datos que satisfarán los requerimientos de análisis, diseñar y construir en SQL el proceso que transforma los datos en los conjuntos de de datos definidos y en algunos casos construir el dashboard en Tableau o Data Studio para la entrega final.

items:
De cara a proyecto de Big Data, demandamos un consultor con el siguiente perfil:

•Experiencia y/o conocimientos profundos de SQL atendiendo a las particularidades de BigQuery sobre todo desde el punto de vista de rendimiento y gasto
•Experiencia y/o conocimientos de modelado de datos
•Experiencia y/o conocimientos de diseño de dashboards en Data Studio y Tableau
•Experiencia y/o conocimientos deseables de Python y Airflow

Funciones:
- Tomar los requerimientos del cliente final o de un analista de negocio, y partiendo de los datos del transaccional o de lo ya disponible en el data hub, diseñar los conjuntos de datos que satisfarán los requerimientos de análisis, diseñar y construir en SQL el proceso que transforma los datos en los conjuntos de de datos definidos y en algunos casos construir el dashboard en Tableau o Data Studio para la entrega final.

jobs_results.title: Consultant (German Speaking) - Data Analytics
jobs_results.description:
-We're Celonis, the global leader in execution management and process mining technology, and one of the 50 most valuable private companies in the world. We believe that every company can unlock its full execution capacity - and for that, we need you to join us.
• *The Team**

Celonis Services is a strategic services organisation that focuses on the technical aspects of our customers' journeys, which includes Consulting Services, Academy and Customer Support. We are thought leaders with deep product, technical and domain expertise and focus on delivering Celonis implementations and driving product adoption for our customers. We achieve this by bringing together our best practices, delivery experience, award-winning enablement, and support expertise.
• *The Role**:
As a **Consultant, Data Analytics (Services) **you will be part of our agile project teams who accelerate our customers’ digital transformation and drive Celonis’ international expansion. To generate high-value use cases, you... will work closely with our customers. You will perform data transformations, develop analyses and derive business cases. You will develop data-driven process insights and actions. You will implement the newest features and functionalities of the Celonis software, such as **Process Automation**, **Task Mining** and **Machine Learning**.
• *The work you'll do**:
Discover
- Be a key player in our agile Celonis implementation project teams, delivering optimal solutions that meet customer needs and solve pain points.
- Design creative analyses and execution apps with a focus on incorporating Machine Learning algorithms and Task Mining to increase process transparency.
- Leverage Celonis technology to uncover process inefficiencies and understand root causes through close collaboration with customers.

Enhance
- Facilitate value creation workshops and align measures to improve process inefficiencies
- Quantify the business and financial potential and present insights to management
- Implement Celonis’ Process Automation technology to streamline customer processes, increase value, and enhance process conformance rates.

Monitor
- Implement KPIs to measure customer success and enable continuous process improvement.
- Ensure customer enablement to continuously improve processes
- Set the foundations of the long-term customer success journey
• *About You**
- You live for customer value, have a passion for driving the Celonis Process Mining Technology forward and a visionary mindset.
- You have a growth mindset and strive for a job that encourages you to continuously expand your knowledge and think creatively.
• *The qualifications you need**:

- Mandatory to have both fluency in English and German
- Min. 2-3 years working experience in **IT-Consulting, Management Consulting, Process Improvement** or a similar area
- Proficiency with **SQL** or other programming languages (Python, R, Matlab...) and a strong interest in Big Data, Data Mining, and Process Mining
- Experience with any types of process related software is a plus
- Excellent **analytical skills**, well organised and known for being a quick learner
- Strong **communication skills** and enjoy interacting with various customers to understand and interpret **business processes**:

- Successfully completed your studies in **Business Informatics, Computer Science, Information-oriented Business Administration/ Economics, Mathematics** or a comparable degree program
• *What Celonis can offer you**:

- The unique opportunity to work within a new category of technology, Execution Management
- Investment in your personal growth and skill development (clear career paths, internal mobility opportunities, L&D platform, mentorships, and more)
- Great compensation and benefits packages (stock options, generous time off, family leave from day one, and more)
- Mental well-being support (LifeWorks Employee Assistance Program, mindfulness tools, virtual events, and more)
- A global and growing team of Celonauts from diverse backgrounds to learn from and work with
- An open-minded culture with innovative, autonomous teams
- A clear set of company values that guide everything we do: Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future
• *About Us**

Celonis reveals and fixes inefficiencies businesses can’t see, enabling them to perform at levels they never thought possible. Powered by its market-leading process mining core, the Celonis Execution Management System provides a full set of platform capabilities for business executives and users to eliminate billions in corporate inefficiencies, provide better customer experience and reduce carbon emissions. Celonis has thousands of implementations with global customers and is headquartered in Munich, Germany and New York City, USA with more than 23 offices worldwide.

Celonis is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment and equal opportunity in all as
